BiblicalUsage: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness, says Isaiah. And Job says the clouds drop and distil upon man abundantly. The word is the dripping itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the heavens drop righteousness the way the clouds drop rain, and God made both.
